text:
mike: Heads up — prepping an on‑prem customer for a locked-down VPC. Need quick eyes on egress rules + RBAC for control plane and KMS integration questions. Ping @jen @tao.
jen: Do we have the runbook link? Prefer outbound NAT + proxy instead of opening many ports. :thumbsup: 
mike: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onprem-egress — notes: customer will use a jump-host. Key Q: can the control plane reach customer KMS via VPC endpoint only? If not we need an offline key-wrap flow.
tao: KMS in private deploy is customer-managed (HSM). We support VPC endpoints or customer NAT. For offline wrap, we accept KMS-encrypted key blobs via our import API. :memo:
sara: On RBAC — proposing read-only tokens for telemetry forwarders, and a dedicated 'ops' role for deploy/rollout. Avoid cluster-admin everywhere. Can we map roles with attribute-based constraints (env, team)?
jen: Agree. For networking: default-deny ingress + egress at namespace level, then explicit allows for api-server, logging sink, and KMS endpoint. Example NetworkPolicy: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-default
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress: []
```
lucas: Vulnerability triage — customer reported CVE-2024-1234 in OpenSSH on the jump host. Recommendation: apply vendor patch + restrict management source ranges. Logged in incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2344
mike: Audit logging question: customer requires logs shipped to their SIEM over TLS only, with secret redaction. Can we guarantee mTLS + field redaction before egress? Ops?
ops: Yes — we use a fluentd forwarder with mutual TLS to the customer's collector and redaction filters. Config excerpt: `filters: - redact_secrets: ["authorization","password"]`. We'll create a dedicated RBAC service account limited to reading audit logs only.
devsec-bot: Reminder — scheduled KMS key rotation due in 7 days for customer-xyz: https://redwood.internal/kms/rotations
tao: Action items: 1) jen to draft NP + RBAC snippets, 2) ops to produce fluentd mTLS + redaction config, 3) mike to confirm KMS connectivity mode with customer. ETA: EOD Thursday. :calendar: 
mike: Added to ops ticket TKT-7890. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
